scope: TI SN7406 reference switching fixture applied to the existing generic DC candidate
interpretation: The measured delay brackets refine within the declared numerical budget. The fast-edge candidate is much faster than the published typical delays; the slower permitted edge produces an output falling threshold crossing before the input midpoint. Maximum-delay compliance alone does not establish device dynamics, and typical values do not uniquely determine semiconductor parameters.
